surface: Current PR body and all API-visible userContentEdits diffs
privacy: Values were compared only in process; no values or prefixes are emitted or retained.
limitation: API-visible edit history only; not GitHub caches, forks, notifications or copies held elsewhere.

residual.branch_history_plan: Rebuild one sanitized commit on current main with an explicit lease; do not include the superseded commit in the rebuilt branch ancestry.
residual.external_copies: Prior public commit objects, caches and external copies may persist. A force-with-lease update cannot certify their deletion.
